availability_decision.note: the public inputs and software make raw-QE/RDN0 reproducible, but it remains a large separate rerun until the four splits, filter/config lock, response, masks, and execution receipt are local. The release-simulation-conditioned null comparison is a concrete result; no raw-QE L=2..10 limit is claimed

crossfit_mean_field.note: the data and 400 simulations are treated as 401 exchangeable units; each score subtracts the mean of the other 400 units. The resulting release-simulation pooled rank is exact only conditional on data/simulation exchangeability after the released reconstruction pipeline

injection_law.note: a stochastic injection whose band-power distribution equals the null's is unidentifiable (its pooled rank against the same null stays uniform); a fixed-template injection is a coherent additive offset that shifts the rank; both are ranked against the SAME null so the distinction is identifiability, not a null-set artifact --- this is not an additive stochastic field (which would itself raise the band power)

inventory.note: the lensing release provides reconstructed convergence and correction/response products. Public four-split CMB maps and open QE software make an independent RDN0 rerun feasible, but the exact inputs, filtering lock, and executed raw-QE stage are not present in this repository

legacy_simulation_only_sensitivity.note: legacy simulation-only LOO sensitivity: data use the all-simulation mean while each simulation uses the other simulations, so the transform is not jointly permutation-equivariant. The naive/cross-fit band-power ratio is the EXACT input-independent ((n-1)/n)^2 sample-size scaling, not a data-dependent measured bias, and the low-multipole mean field is numerically negligible so the cross-fit is the principled construction rather than a large correction on this data --- it is reported as a secondary sensitivity

rank_ceiling.note: exact algebraic ceiling: the low-multipole band carries sum(2 ell + 1) real dof, capped by the mean-field-subtracted sample rank n_sims - 1; the realized numerical covariance rank was not measured
